questions.question: What complaint did the circumcised believers in Jerusalem bring against the apostle Peter?

answers.text: He visited uncircumcised men and ate with them
He baptized people without asking the apostles
He stayed away from Jerusalem far too long

questions.question: In Peter's vision of a sheet of animals, a voice from heaven told him not to call anything impure that God has made clean. True or false?
When the Holy Spirit fell on the Gentile man's household in Caesarea, how did Peter say it compared with what happened to the first believers?
After Peter explained what happened at the Gentile man's house in Caesarea, what did the believers in Jerusalem do?

answers.text: They sent for the man in Caesarea
